html:
The Phong Nha Ho Chi Minh Trail Cycling Tour offers an adventurous and immersive way to explore the stunning landscapes and historic trails of Phong Nha.

Cycle through rice paddies, peanut fields, rivers, and jungle paths while discovering Vietnam’s history along the legendary Ho Chi Minh trails.

This tour is ideal for travelers who love physical challenges, outdoor adventure, and learning about local culture and wartime history, all while enjoying breathtaking mountain views and pristine nature.

WHAT TO BRING

  • Sunglasses

  • Sun cream

  • Cycling shoes

  • Swimming gear

We provide:

  • Bottles of water, soft drinks, seasonal fruits, and snacks

  • International standard mountain bikes (Trek/Giant or similar) and helmets

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30 – Pick up from your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha. Receive a briefing on cycling traffic rules and safety before starting the tour.

08:45 – Cycle from Phong Nha town toward Phong Nha National Park. Pass through corn and rice fields along the Son River to Na Village, a floating fishing farm. Learn about local culture, rice farming, and fish feeding from your guide.

Visit Ho Khanh’s house, the jungle man who discovered Son Doong Cave, the world’s largest cave. Opportunity for photos if available.

Cycle through peanut fields and explore the original Ho Chi Minh trails, historically used to transport soldiers and supplies during the Vietnam War. Cross muddy paths and peanut fields along the Chay River to reach HCM HW (West Wing).

Enjoy lunch at Chay Lap Homestay or Nuoc Mooc Spring, with an option to swim in the pristine jungle spring.

Cycle across Chay River via a wooden bridge to explore the Wine Cave, where rice wine was historically made during wartime. Learn about its significance and peace symbol.

Return to Phong Nha town by 16:30, with an optional ice-cream break.

INCLUSIONS

  • Entrance fees

  • First-aid service

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Boat on Son River and local ferry fees

  • Cold drinks (Revive, coke) and water (unlimited)

  • Mountain bike with helmet (Trek/Giant or similar) with mechanic support

  • English-speaking cycling guide (escorted guide for groups of 9 or more)

  • Pick up and drop off at your hotel in Phong Nha

EXCLUSIONS

  • Tourist insurance

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips for guide/driver

  • Services not mentioned above

CHILD POLICY

  • Children from 9 to 11 years old: half price
